title: Finite rational adjunction for proper compact support
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, ell a prime distinct from its characteristic, and E/Q_ell a finite extension. Let p:X→Y be a proper map over D.k between finite-type quasi-compact D.k-schemes, without separatedness of their structure maps. In the recorded integral and raw rational constructible categories [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the actual rational inverse image Lp* is left adjoint to the fixed finite compact-support functor for the identity-open compactification (id_X,p). The adjunction is constructed by restricting reduction/system adjunctions, transporting the strict identity-open comparison, then tensor-localizing its unit and counit.

source.place: Proper image paragraph, together with SGA 4 XVII §5 and Bhatt--Scholze 6.7.2 and 6.7.6–6.7.7. Separate finite-stage compatibility assertion needed in the common-stage comparison.

proof.text: Restrict the composite reduction/limit and system pullback/direct-image adjunction using the fully faithful constructible inclusion and its complete reduction. This is the same restriction argument as the integral linear adjunction.

Remove identity open on the entire strict compact-support tower using ProperIntegralTower.integralComparison; full constructible inclusion lifts this natural isomorphism. Transport the right functor of the restricted adjunction.

Use the proved liftLinear and liftAdjunction constructions to tensor both functors and unit/counit at the uniformizer. The pure-tensor characterization identifies the left functor with rationalDerivedPullback, while the right functor is the literal sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor.

proof_origin: C6 stage 3, 2026-10-25: separate finite proper-image part of the recorded compact-support comparison; common-stage descent and open/proper composition remain in the parent.

lean.statement:
theorem properSupportFiniteAdjunction
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsProper p]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    Nonempty (rationalDerivedPullback l E p ⊣
      sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k (finiteFieldDatumPrimeUnit D l hl)
        (Compactification.ofIsProper p) E)
